fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 5.5% of annualized monthly GS <$1M; 5.0% for $1M+. Monthly minimum royalty for 1 territory: $0 (mo 1-6), $400 (mo 7-12), $500 (mo 13-24), $600 (mo 25+). Brand Development Fund currently 1% GS or $150/territory/month (max 2% cap). Local marketing 2% GS or $150/territory/month (franchisee-directed). Website fee $100/month. Business Management System license $180/month for up to 10 clients + $12/client over 10. Client satisfaction portal $81/month. Bookkeeping $400/month (first 12 months).
